operator_source_descriptions.ATT-02:two-level-feedback-normalization: Bottom and top visual layers apply local untuned divisive normalization (Eqs.2-3 and 5-6) while exchanging feedforward/modulatory signals.

operator_source_descriptions.INT-09:state-dependent-observation-estim: Kalman-style state estimator whose sensory observation reliability depends on movement state/visibility, so observation noise is state dependent.
operator_source_descriptions.INT-09:affine-feedback-feedforward-contr: Optimal controller has an affine control law; feedback acts on estimated state while a nonzero feedforward term appears when sensory reliability depends affinely on state.
operator_source_descriptions.INT-09:alternating-control-estimation-op: Control sequence and estimator gain are alternately updated to convergence because signal- and state-dependent noise breaks the classical separation of controller and estimator.

adverse_source_limits: Original live Fig9 caption remains historically distinct from the publisher correction; W5 never overwrites the original record.
The correction repairs only the Fig9 legend panel relation and is not evidence for a different central model.
S1 Text bytes were not independently frozen; no claim of exhaustive model mathematics is made.

profiles.edition_identity: 2023 current PLOS article; Funding-only correction recorded separately
profiles.source_scope: Central BG motor-selection/novelty-learning and cerebellar reservoir/CPG mechanisms from the publisher article; earlier proof and Funding correction remain separate editions.

operator_source_descriptions.INT-10:bg-novelty-hebbian-goal-action-ma: Motor basal ganglia select concrete actions and learn goal-to-action associations with dopamine-modulated three-factor Hebbian plasticity driven by movement novelty.
operator_source_descriptions.INT-10:cerebellar-reservoir-error-correc: A recurrent reservoir learns endpoint-error-dependent corrections to CPG motor-program parameters, refining actions selected by the basal-ganglia system.
operator_source_descriptions.INT-10:bg-cerebellum-serial-motor-learni: The central full model composes strategic/concrete BG action selection with cerebellar correction of motor execution rather than treating either subsystem alone as the complete learner.

adverse_source_limits: The June 2023 correction is Funding-only and cannot be promoted into a scientific model revision.
The prior BG papers are direct ancestors of the BG constituent; this does not make the full BG+cerebellum model identical to those ancestors.
W5 does not silently equate the earlier proof with the current publisher article.

profiles.edition_identity: 2026 PLOS Version of Record/current publisher article
profiles.source_scope: Publisher main article central FI, OI and joint inference mechanisms and explicit inherited model references; no exhaustive correction registry claim.

operator_source_descriptions.INT-11:feature-successor-context-inferen: Feature inference maintains context-specific successor-feature maps and a Bayesian belief over latent contexts using prediction mismatch and a sticky-CRP prior.
operator_source_descriptions.INT-11:outcome-map-context-inference: Outcome inference reuses an existing transfer-learning model with context-specific outcome/reward predictive maps to infer latent context from behavioral outcomes.
operator_source_descriptions.INT-11:joint-feature-outcome-context-int: The tested joint strategy combines feature-based and outcome-based contextual evidence, then uses context-conditioned learned action/value representations for choice.

adverse_source_limits: Feature inference and outcome inference are explicitly inherited components; W5 does not claim de-novo invention of either.
Latent context belief is distinct from learned maps, task/world variables and empirical outcome measures.
Source-reported switching/control variants remain noncanonical.

profiles.edition_identity: 2018 PLOS Version of Record/current publisher article
profiles.source_scope: Publisher main article independent/joint clustering, CRP inference, planning and meta-agent; S1 unknown-transition implementation is retained as noncanonical because W5 did not byte-freeze it.

operator_source_descriptions.INT-12:independent-reward-mapping-crp: Independent clustering assigns a context separately to reward-function and mapping/transition-function clusters under CRP priors, enabling recombination across contexts.
operator_source_descriptions.INT-12:component-binding-planning: Separately learned reward and mapping/transition functions are bound through planning to construct a policy for the current context.
operator_source_descriptions.INT-12:joint-task-clustering-comparator: Joint clustering assigns each context to one holistic cluster governing both functions and serves as the explicit non-compositional comparison inherited from prior task-structure models.

adverse_source_limits: The paper explicitly leaves open whether human learning is better described by independent, joint or a mixture of the two.
The unknown-transition S1 variant is not byte-frozen and cannot be promoted to W5 canonical.
Control/gating/hierarchy vocabulary alone is not ancestry evidence for P11, P12 or other CTL papers.

edition_identity.firstparty_live_recheck_2026_10_05: PLOS page still explicitly labels article 'uncorrected proof'; no silent edition upgrade

profiles.source_scope: Exact author-adopted publisher proof + prior G2-D source science + 2026-10-05 first-party PLOS HTML recheck. Proof is the study edition, not a corrected final VoR.

operator_source_descriptions.INT-13:parallel-rlwm-update-mixture: Parallel RL and working-memory value updates form the source policy; WM provides rapid capacity-limited learning while RL is slower and incremental.
operator_source_descriptions.INT-13:lba-choice-rt-accumulation: The source augments RLWM with a linear ballistic accumulator so action values drive multiple response accumulators and both choice and reaction-time distributions are fit jointly.
operator_source_descriptions.INT-13:setsize-proactive-bound: The decision threshold is modeled as a function of set size, with collapsing-bound and fixed-bound alternatives used to test proactive response caution.

additional_edition_bundle.note: NO_CORRECTED_FINAL_VOR_IDENTIFIED; current first-party page remains an uncorrected proof as of 2026-10-05

adverse_source_limits: Adopted edition is an uncorrected publisher proof and must never be relabeled as a corrected final VoR.
RLWM and LBA are inherited constituents; the paper is not treated as first invention of either.
Clinical fitted mechanisms do not establish a causal neural implementation.
S1 Text was identified first-party but its raw byte SHA was not obtained in W6.
Direct ancestry list is source-supported but not exhaustive.

edition_identity.firstparty_live_recheck_2026_10_05: Publisher HTML identifies published 2020 article and S1 Appendix.

profiles.source_scope: Inherited exact PLOS raw PDF receipt, existing INT01×INT14 source-native audit, and current first-party HTML review of theoretical model, inference, planning, limits and S1 Appendix.

operator_source_descriptions.INT-14:connected-crp-graph-hierarchy: A CRP prior clusters graph states subject to a connected-cluster constraint, yielding a hierarchical graph with bridge structure rather than task-set/action-policy clusters.
operator_source_descriptions.INT-14:mcmc-hierarchy-posterior: The source estimates the posterior over latent hierarchies with Metropolis-within-Gibbs sampling because exact posterior inference is intractable.
operator_source_descriptions.INT-14:hierarchical-bfs-planning: The inferred hierarchy is used for hierarchical shortest-path planning with HBFS and for hierarchy-conditioned behavioral predictions.

additional_edition_bundle.role: S1 Appendix supplemental results, methods, and discussion

additional_edition_bundle.note: NO_CORRECTION IDENTIFIED IN W6 FIRSTPARTY ARTICLE-PAGE REVIEW; NOT AN EXHAUSTIVE PUBLISHER CORRECTION INDEX CLAIM

adverse_source_limits: Shared CRP with INT-01 is a constituent only; clustered object, posterior/update and planning target differ.
The paper does not establish global optimality of the whole generative model.
HBFS is used as a planning realization without a strong claim that it is the unique cognitively plausible planner.
Large-graph exact posterior inference is intractable and approximated by MCMC.
No direct ancestor DOI is promoted from thematic or experimental predecessor citations alone.

edition_identity.firstparty_live_recheck_2026_10_05: Publisher HTML identifies the 2022 research article and S1 Text.

profiles.source_scope: Inherited PLOS raw PDF, prior bounded G1 P18 comparison, INT01 source-scoped comparison, and current first-party HTML review of MB/MF value computation, conflict-sensitive drift diffusion, variants and adverse limits.

operator_source_descriptions.INT-15:mb-mf-value-computation: Model-based and model-free reinforcement-learning values are computed for the two-step task and provide the value inputs and conflict quantities used by the decision layer.
operator_source_descriptions.INT-15:conflict-sensitive-ddm: A drift-diffusion model uses MB/MF value and conflict regressors to explain choices and reaction times, separating value influence from decision-process effects.
operator_source_descriptions.INT-15:boundary-caution-modulation: Decision boundary separation changes with value conflict, operationalizing a conflict-related change in response caution rather than a new value-learning rule.

additional_edition_bundle.role: S1 Text parameter estimates and auxiliary analyses

additional_edition_bundle.note: NO_CORRECTION IDENTIFIED IN W6 FIRSTPARTY ARTICLE-PAGE REVIEW; NOT AN EXHAUSTIVE PUBLISHER CORRECTION INDEX CLAIM

adverse_source_limits: Within-system and between-system conflict are substantially correlated, and the task does not empirically identify a unique exact conflict form.
The paper explicitly describes the combined DDM as a statistical approximation rather than a mechanistic account of the full cognitive decision process.
Generic MB/MF components and standard RL are inherited constituents, not evidence of a globally independent family.
Bounded difference from G1 P18 concerns tested operators only and does not certify genealogical independence.

edition_identity.firstparty_live_recheck_2026_10_05: Publisher HTML identifies the 2015 research article; W6 did not identify a paper-specific supporting-information object on the current page.

profiles.source_scope: Inherited PLOS raw PDF, prior bounded G1 P09 comparison, and current first-party HTML review of AuGMEnT learning equations, attentional feedback tags, traces, RPE-gated plasticity, SARSA(lambda) correspondence and source limits.

operator_source_descriptions.INT-16:response-feedback-synaptic-tags: Selected responses send attentional feedback to earlier association/memory stages, turning locally maintained traces into synaptic tags for delayed credit assignment.
operator_source_descriptions.INT-16:neuromodulated-tagged-plasticity: A global reward-prediction-error neuromodulatory signal interacts with tagged synapses to determine plasticity while tag formation itself depends on local information.
operator_source_descriptions.INT-16:sarsa-lambda-tag-correspondence: The source derives a precise correspondence between AuGMEnT tag decay and SARSA(lambda) eligibility traces under alpha = 1 - lambda gamma.

additional_edition_bundle.note: NO CORRECTION OR PAPER-SPECIFIC SUPPORTING FILE IDENTIFIED IN W6 FIRSTPARTY ARTICLE-PAGE REVIEW; NOT AN EXHAUSTIVE PUBLISHER INDEX CLAIM

adverse_source_limits: The model does not specify a unique biological mechanism generating persistent activity; recurrent activity is one of several possible implementations discussed.
Synaptic tags correspond to eligibility traces and AuGMEnT maps to SARSA(lambda), so generic reinforcement-plasticity language cannot establish an independent family.
The source is a biologically plausible network simulation, not direct in-vivo confirmation of the proposed synapse-specific mechanism.
Generic neuromodulatory plasticity is insufficient to identify it with G1 P09's bee mushroom-body relational categorization model.

profiles.source_scope: Generic policy-gradient update, latent representation structure, task schedule and comparator models are separated; the paper-specific center is efficient-coding compression coupled to reward.

operator_source_descriptions.LRN-01:reward-minus-mutual-information-o: ECPG maximizes expected reward above baseline minus lambda I(S;Z)
operator_source_descriptions.LRN-01:latent-encoder-decoder-policy: policy factorizes through encoder psi(z|s) and decoder rho(a|z)
operator_source_descriptions.LRN-01:encoder-decoder-policy-gradient: encoder and decoder parameters are policy-gradient optimized under the coupled reward/compression objective
operator_source_descriptions.LRN-01:feature-efficient-coding-extensio: CPG is lambda=0; RLPG omits latent compression; feature variants add experimenter-defined feature embeddings

additional_edition_bundle.role: same-article derivation, architecture, parameter, recovery and control details referenced by the Version of Record

adverse_source_limits: Generic policy-gradient RL is inherited and is not counted as a novel learning rule.
Model fitting used all training and testing behavioral data without cross-validation because block count was insufficient.
Feature-based variants use an experimenter-defined feature embedding.
The source supports a tested computational account, not a direct neural implementation claim.

profiles.source_scope: Learning/inference rule is separated from exogenous switching schedule and softmax choice readout; generic Kalman/Bayesian machinery is inherited.

operator_source_descriptions.LRN-02:volatile-kalman-mean-update: state mean/variance update follows Kalman filtering with fixed process variance replaced by estimated volatility v_(t-1)
operator_source_descriptions.LRN-02:volatility-error-correction: volatility update corrects E[(x_t-x_(t-1))^2]-v_(t-1) with lambda as volatility update rate
operator_source_descriptions.LRN-02:binary-moment-matching-update: lambda=0 gives a standard Kalman-filter special case
operator_source_descriptions.LRN-02:latent-space-volatility-learning-: binary VKF uses Bernoulli-sigmoid observations and moment matching with inference noise omega

additional_edition_bundle.role: formal treatment of VKF generative model and inference
formal treatment of implied observation-space learning rate

adverse_source_limits: The full two-chain VKF still requires structured variational approximation.
Binary outcomes require additional moment matching and an inference-only noise parameter.
Several simulations use switching dynamics that do not exactly match the Gaussian-random-walk generative assumptions.
Latent-space and observation-space learning-rate signals are not equivalent and must not be collapsed.

profiles.source_scope: Reward learning rule and network representation are separated from task/environment schedule and biological interpretation; recurrent policy gradient is inherited.

operator_source_descriptions.LRN-03:recurrent-policy-gradient-decisio: decision RNN defines a stochastic recurrent policy optimized by REINFORCE/recurrent policy gradient
operator_source_descriptions.LRN-03:value-network-reward-baseline: value RNN reads decision activity plus selected actions to predict future return and supplies a variance-reducing baseline
operator_source_descriptions.LRN-03:reward-based-rnn-weight-update: value network guides learning but task execution after learning depends on decision network
operator_source_descriptions.LRN-03:policy-only-task-execution: weights are optimized by gradient methods through recurrent networks while environment fixes observations, rewards and action timing

additional_edition_bundle.role: publisher-integrated figure supplements; no separate external mathematical appendix required for the central learning rule

adverse_source_limits: The source explicitly builds on recurrent policy-gradient/REINFORCE; that training method is not de novo.
Biological constraints on architecture, dynamics and synaptic plasticity are weak; the learning rule is not biologically plausible.
The network is a modeling tool, not direct evidence that the brain implements the same gradient algorithm.
The value network improves learning reliability but is dispensable for task execution after learning.

operator_source_descriptions.MEM-02:semantic-generative-model: A learned latent-variable generative model of environmental statistics is assigned to semantic memory and supplies the decoder/prior used to reconstruct compressed episodes.
operator_source_descriptions.MEM-02:beta-vae-rate-distortion-encoding: A beta-VAE approximate posterior q_phi(z|x), generative likelihood p_theta(x|z), and prior p_theta(z) instantiate a rate-distortion trade-off; beta scales the information/capacity regularization.
operator_source_descriptions.MEM-02:latent-posterior-reconstruction: Episode-specific information is represented through latent z and reconstructed through the learned decoder, producing gist/prototype-biased recall under compression.
operator_source_descriptions.MEM-02:delay-indexed-compression-variant: Delayed forgetting is represented by moving toward lower rate/higher beta; in the experiments separate models/compression settings are used for levels of delay rather than a demonstrated within-trace biological consolidation operator.

source_loci: PLOS theoretical framework: rate-distortion theory, VAE/beta-VAE, information bottleneck; Materials and Methods model architectures; delayed-forgetting analysis

adverse_source_limits: The work targets qualitative memory phenomena; several hyperparameters are chosen to place reconstructions in an experimentally comparable regime rather than uniquely fit a biological mechanism.
For delayed recall, forgetting is modeled with separate compression levels/models; this does not establish a biological storage or consolidation update acting on one persisting trace.
The paper notes that converting a lower-beta representation to a higher-beta representation is not guaranteed when required information has already been lost.
Delay-to-beta mapping is a model calibration/interpretive bridge, not a measured neural variable.

operator_source_descriptions.PRD-02:reward-structure-belief-state: The Bayesian RL state includes uncertainty over reward probabilities and a hidden binary coupling structure (independent versus coupled reward generation).
operator_source_descriptions.PRD-02:bayesian-reward-and-structure-upd: Observed reward histories update posterior probability over reward parameters and coupling structure; structure uncertainty gates how evidence transfers between options.
operator_source_descriptions.PRD-02:belief-state-optimal-action-selec: Actions are valued from the belief state under Bayesian reinforcement learning, balancing information gathering/exploration with reward rather than applying a fixed predictive-coding error rule.
operator_source_descriptions.PRD-02:fixed-structure-and-q-learning-co: Fixed independent, fixed coupled, and model-free Q-learning/softmax are explicit comparison variants, not components to merge into the central structure-learning model.

source_loci: PLOS Structure learning model with Bayesian reinforcement learning; graphical reward-generation models; belief-state action selection; model comparison; Methods

adverse_source_limits: The task's independent/coupled reward-generation alternatives are experimenter-defined candidate structures; they are not evidence of a universal internal generative model.
The authors explicitly ignore dependencies across trials and note that reward-structure learning ultimately must be integrated with temporal-dependency learning.
A nontrivial subset of choices is not captured by the compared models; behavioral fit does not establish a neural implementation.
Q-learning with softmax is a comparator and must not be treated as the paper's source-native central family.

operator_source_descriptions.PRD-03:hidden-trial-state-transition: A Hidden Markov Model represents latent trial type and the experiment-defined cyclic transition structure across lead/test/trail states.
operator_source_descriptions.PRD-03:observation-likelihood-integratio: Frequency and price observations supply likelihood evidence for latent trial state and are integrated with prior/past-state evidence.
operator_source_descriptions.PRD-03:past-evidence-uncertainty-gate: Intermediate matrix B, parameterized by gamma, degrades use of past evidence: gamma=0 preserves past-state determination and gamma=1 ignores past information.
operator_source_descriptions.PRD-03:posterior-response-likelihood: Posterior state certainty is mapped to observed response likelihood for fitting; gamma and observation-noise sigma are estimated across training tertiles.

source_loci: PLOS HMM model, intermediate B/gamma uncertainty matrix, alternative model comparison, Eqs. 5-8 parameter-fit methods; S1-S4 figure declarations

adverse_source_limits: The latent transition structure is experiment-defined; the fitted HMM describes subjects' inference within that world and is not itself evidence that the transition structure was neurally learned by the same operator.
The paper does not model initial acquisition of the overall world-model structure; changes in gamma characterize improved use of past evidence.
Gamma and sigma can be moderately anticorrelated, limiting unique mechanistic interpretation.
A more complex asymmetric B variant helps some subjects but is not adopted as the average central model.

operator_source_descriptions.SKL-02:sorn-recurrent-state-transition: Sparse recurrent excitatory/inhibitory threshold units form a SORN reservoir whose activity state is driven by sequence-specific external input.
operator_source_descriptions.SKL-02:stdp-recurrent-weight-update: Temporally asymmetric STDP modifies recurrent excitatory connections and supports learned sequence-specific trajectories.
operator_source_descriptions.SKL-02:intrinsic-plasticity-threshold-up: Intrinsic plasticity changes excitability/thresholds to regulate firing statistics; it is a distinct homeostatic mechanism from STDP.
operator_source_descriptions.SKL-02:synaptic-normalization: Incoming recurrent weights are normalized, stabilizing the adaptive reservoir jointly with intrinsic plasticity.
operator_source_descriptions.SKL-02:supervised-motor-readout: A separate motor/output layer is trained from reservoir states; the human motor task is an imposed simulation mapping and must not be conflated with a biological inverse controller.

source_loci: PLOS Methods: SORN network architecture and plasticity; Results sequence-learning simulations; Supporting S1-S6 parameter-sensitivity figures

adverse_source_limits: The SORN is a computational neural-network model fitted qualitatively to multiple human sequence-learning experiments; it is not a direct measurement of synaptic STDP/IP/SN in those participants.
The task-specific motor output/readout is supervised and externally defined; the recurrent network should not be mislabeled as an endogenous inverse motor model.
Interference/facilitation emerge from the inherited SORN plasticity architecture; they are not evidence that the paper independently invented the SORN family.
